report.summary: Chunk 5 of 7: Contains _store_batch, ingest_events_report, ingest_events, ingest_transport_records_report, ingest_transport_records methods.
risks: ingest_events_report | medium | The method returns IngestReport with 'empty' status when attempted==0, but spec is set to None. Downstream consumers may not handle None spec. | Check if callers handle None spec.

ingest_events_report | medium | The method catches TypeError and ValueError from _validate_batch and _store_batch, but also from other operations; the error messages are generic. | Verify that exceptions are properly distinguished.

ingest_events_report | low | The docstring says 'return an explicit, non-throwing service report' but the method can raise ValueError for invalid batch_size or normalization. | Consider removing the claim or handling those cases internally.

handoff.purpose: Defines methods for storing batches of projections and ingesting events/transport records with reporting.

symbols.name: _store_batch
symbols.note: Inserts into projection_sources and event_projections tables; returns count of inserted projections.

symbols.name: ingest_events_report
symbols.note: Public method that projects AgentEvents and returns an IngestReport. Handles batching, embedding, validation, identity drift, and storage.

symbols.name: ingest_events
symbols.note: Compatibility wrapper around ingest_events_report returning number of new projections.

symbols.name: ingest_transport_records_report
symbols.note: Converts TransportRecords to AgentEvents and calls ingest_events_report.

symbols.name: ingest_transport_records
symbols.note: Compatibility wrapper around ingest_transport_records_report returning number of new projections.

claims.text: Project events and return an explicit, non-throwing service report.
claims.why: The method raises ValueError for invalid batch_size or normalization, contradicting 'non-throwing'.
The code raises ValueError('batch_size must be positive') if batch_size <= 0.
The code raises ValueError("normalization must be 'l2' or 'none'") if normalization not in {'l2', 'none'}.

claims.text: Refuse BEFORE writing: a drifted backend must never contribute a single vector to an index built in another coordinate system.
claims.why: The code calls _verify_identity and returns drift if not None before storing.

claims.text: Compatibility wrapper returning the number of new projections.
Project lossless shell records without replacing their event journal.
claims.why: The claim about 'without replacing their event journal' cannot be verified from this chunk; the method converts records to AgentEvents and calls ingest_events_report, which stores projections. The event journal is not in this chunk.

claims.text: Compatibility wrapper returning the number of new projections.

observations.what: _store_batch inserts into projection_sources and event_projections tables using INSERT OR IGNORE, so duplicates are silently skipped.
ingest_events_report returns IngestReport with 'empty' status when attempted==0, but spec is set to None.
The method catches TypeError and ValueError from _validate_batch and _store_batch, but also from other operations; the error messages are generic.
The docstring claims 'non-throwing' but the method raises ValueError for invalid inputs.
